title: Benchmark Schema
description: The version 1 schema for one benchmark project: the pinned repository and its review cases, each with the checks a review must find. Every review covers the whole repository.

id.description: The project directory name, which equals the repository name at the end of repository.url when a url is given.

repositoryPath.description: A repository-root-relative POSIX path such as src/documents/views.py, without a leading ./ or / and without backslashes or .. segments.

repository.description: The reviewed git repository, named by exactly one of url and local_path, and the commit the repository case reviews.

location.description: A source location hint: a file with either a line or a symbol. A symbol is a qualified name without parentheses, signature, or line number: Class.method, Class, or function.

changeAnchor.description: One changed line of the reviewed diff that establishes the check identity, on the new or old side.

checkId.description: <subject>-<weakness> in kebab-case. subject names the feature or component that holds the defect, such as mail-test or storage-path-template. weakness is one of: missing-permission (model or object permission check missing), idor (object fetched by id without ownership or visibility scoping), missing-owner (created object has no owner and becomes visible to all), privilege-escalation, information-disclosure, path-traversal, stored-xss, ssrf, csrf, injection, denial-of-service, authentication-bypass, symlink-following, accounting-error (balance, share, reward, or fee bookkeeping that loses, misroutes, or mis-scales value), pricing-error (a price or valuation that is stale, inflated, or zero where it sets trade or redemption amounts), front-running (an outcome that depends on transaction ordering without a caller-supplied bound), open-redirect (a redirect target check that lets a request send users to another site). One vulnerability keeps one id across cases, and distinct vulnerabilities of one case get distinct ids.

rootCause.description: Exactly one present-tense sentence without a trailing period: the code element that holds the defect, then the missing or broken control, then what it fails to protect. Code positions use the repository-relative form src/documents/views.py:LINE. No attacker narrative or severity words.

repositoryCase.description: A review of the whole repository at repository.commit. Its id is repository-<first 7 hex of repository.commit>.

diffCase.description: A review of the change base..commit. Its id is diff-<first 7 hex of commit>, and every check carries change_anchors.
